pages.text: A boombox is necessary for those who travel and do not want to constantly put music blocks, put Music Discs or links in them - everything with them. We take the boombox in the LMB inventory, aim at the plate we need and press the RMB, thereby placing it in the boombox.

pages.title: The Boombox
pages.text: After doing the same, but with an empty inventory slot, he will give you the plate back. You can also do the opposite - RMB on it with a plate to give it away and just RMB on it to take it away.

After exiting the inventory and pressing the key combination Shift+RMB, the boombox will start playing the track. Music can be paused by pressing the keyboard shortcut Shift+RMB. But after you remove the pause, the music starts all over again... It holds only one Music Disc.
